question: Within the published constant-parameter two-hemitrich ray model, how does prescribed base sliding change normalized ray curvature and shape under a fixed uniform load, and what is the unloaded generalized base-shift stiffness?
scope: Static planar single segmented bluegill-ray model, not flying-fish calibration, aggregate fin EI, tissue-growth or muscle/neuronal actuator validation

source.title: The mechanics of active fin-shape control in ray-finned fishes
source.read_method: Direct public author PDF; text extraction and original Fig8 page image inspected. PMC later reCAPTCHA, Jina unsuccessful.
selectors: Sec5.3 Eq5.2 uniform loading and Fig8b

equations.equilibrium: -2 B phi_ss + G phi - p d (1-s)=0
equations.derived_unloaded_base_stiffness: d2U/dphi0^2=2 B a coth(a)/d^2; derived here from energy for p=0,fusedtip; not measured stiffness

units.G: G_dim*L^2/B0, G_dim inN =3Dshear modulus(Pa)*intraray cross-sectional area(m^2); not Pa
units.p: p_dim*L^3/B0, p_dim force per ray arclength N/m, not pressurePa; derived dimensional balance
units.base_shift_stiffness: K_dim*L^3/B0, generalized axial sliding stiffness N/m, not bending EI

cases.source_parameters: B1,d.01,G200,phi0.01,p200 printed Sec5.3/Fig8b; all other values declared illustrative design perturbations, not sampled measurements

methods.reference: published Eq5.2 analytic phi and derivative; not an independent biological solver

controls.printed_cancellation: source parameters give pd/G=phi0 exactly; curvature=1, circle tip x=sin(1),y=1-cos(1)
controls.numerical_refinement: recompute at tol1e-8 and1e-10, report both errors; no observed order claim

source_disagreement.printed_Eq5_2_and_parameters: predict constant positive curvature at the stated parameters
source_disagreement.printed_Fig8b_and_text: show/describe S-shaped reversal for same listed parameters; caption also cites Eq5.1 for uniform load
source_disagreement.rule: Preserve discrepancy; no parameter/sign tuning, digitized fit or claim of Fig8 reproduction

unknown: unsteady load orientation and fluid interaction

status: Frozen before any per-ray numerical outputs

pre_run_domain_clarification.curvature_gap_product: Report max(abs(kappa*d)) for every case. Paper thin-layer derivation assumes d/L<<1 and curvature of order1/L; high-G boundary localization can violate that asymptotic ordering even when d/L=.01. No source-proven sharp numerical validity cutoff is available. Values>=.1 receive a descriptive caution (engineering reference only), never a biological or asymptotic-validity PASS. Preserve all declared24outputs with applicability flags.
pre_run_domain_clarification.stiffness_scope: Generalized unloaded sliding stiffness only, p=0; no loaded muscle force, active-control power or whole-fin bending EI inferred.
pre_run_domain_clarification.signs: positive p uses exactly the printed M_ext=p(1-s)^2/2 convention; no sign repair to matchFig8.
